name: Bell-Chime Katzbalger
source:
Friend of Honey's.

A meek but energetic wolf, and the outcast of a powerful noble family. A recent friend of Honey's, and adores everything about her. Has a playful and joyous demeanour, but finds a lot of things in life difficult, and has a rather troubled personality at heart.

Sign: Pisces
Favourite Food: None.
Hobbies: Collecting and photographing dolls, Producing strange comics under a pseudonym.
Likes: Honey, Flowers, Holding hands.
Dislikes: Would rather not say.

[From [url=https://coquettedragoon.com/cast/]official website[/url]]
